law_name: Law of 1 August 2018 on the organisation of the CNPD and the general data protection regime
key_requirements: GDPR applies: lawful basis, data subject rights, breach notification
deceased_data: Not covered: no specific national rule for deceased persons (GDPR recital 27 option not used); medical secrecy (Penal Code art. 458) still applies (unconfirmed)
research_exemption: Derogations for scientific/historical research, statistics and archiving restricting rights (arts. 15,16,18,21 GDPR) with safeguards (arts. 63-65)
genetic_data: Special category (art. 9 GDPR); processing of genetic data to exercise controller rights in labour law and insurance is prohibited
